tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: Primary brand color. Primary-button fill, the global link color, logo tint. Note: the codebase also sets this directly as body-text link color on white — that pair is ~1.9:1, well under WCAG AA (4.5:1). Kept as-is from the source; pair link text with an underline or swap to `ink-navy` where links sit in body copy.

tokens.name: brand-blue-dark
tokens.usage: Secondary blue accent — icon links and small text on light surfaces (events/creator flows). ~4:1 on white: fine for icons and large text, borderline for small body text.

tokens.name: brand-blue-tint
tokens.usage: Hover fill for primary (blue) buttons.

tokens.name: brand-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Soft blue tinted background for highlighted panels and form sections. The source has several near-duplicate tints (#eef9fd, #f3fafc); this is the canonical one — consolidate the others here.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Hover color for links and footer text on dark surfaces. Named `--surfmate-light-blue` in the source, but the hex is a mint green, not a blue — flagged here rather than silently renamed.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary body text on light surfaces. Also the fill for dark surfaces: header after scroll, footer, the dark waitlist section, the story section.

tokens.name: ink-navy
tokens.usage: Deep navy text set on blue fills (primary-button labels, form input text) and headings on the events/creator flows. Distinct from `ink` in the source — kept separate rather than merged.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background; card and input fill.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Muted section background (`--surfmate-light-gray`).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover background for secondary/ghost buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Dark card and panel ground used across the events pages (event cards, filters).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default control border — inputs, secondary/ghost buttons.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers, e.g. under the signed-in bar.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary body copy on light surfaces.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata and helper text. ~4.8:1 on white — passes AA for normal text.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled text only — ~2.5:1 on white, below AA. Never use for body copy; the source only ever uses it for placeholders and a disabled button label.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and icons (form success states).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner and badge background, paired with `success` text.

tokens.name: success-strong
tokens.usage: The pulsing "live now" indicator dot on event cards.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive messaging.

tokens.name: error-border
tokens.usage: Invalid-field border on form inputs.

tokens.name: badge-partner-bg
tokens.usage: Background for the "Partner" event-card badge, on `surface-dark`.

tokens.name: badge-partner-text
tokens.usage: Text for the "Partner" event-card badge.

tokens.name: badge-live-bg
tokens.usage: Background for the "Live" event-card badge, on `surface-dark`.

tokens.name: badge-live-text
tokens.usage: Text for the "Live" event-card badge, paired with the `success-strong` dot.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Condensed, heavy (900) display face for the hero and h1/h2 only. Sits optically high — the source adds a small top-padding offset wherever Seattle body text follows it.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The single hero headline on the homepage.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Seattle is the workhorse face for everything below a section heading — headings h3+ in bold, running copy in regular.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Surfmate helps you find surf spots, log sessions, and meet other surfers.
styles.usage: Running body copy, the default for `p`.

groups.name: UI
groups.note: Inter, for interface chrome: buttons, badges, labels, meta text — never long-form copy.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Compact buttons in forms and cards.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Footer links and small metadata rows.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Tight gaps — icon to label, nav-toggle bars.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, nav-link padding.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Container side padding (mobile), card gaps.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Between related elements — nav gap, heading margins.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Container side padding (desktop), footer vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Large section padding (e.g. the waitlist band).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons (event-submit flow), nav-link hover state.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Larger cards, the mobile nav-menu panel, event-card logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The event card — the site's largest rounded surface.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, the waitlist input, badges and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Subtle resting elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards and dropdowns at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: The mobile nav-menu panel, elevated popovers.
